text:
Christopher Columbus.

It is truly heartwarming to witness the corporate world’s relentless dedication to "innovation," specifically the groundbreaking strategy of taking a product that has functioned perfectly well for decades, slapping a new pastel hue on it, and charging 40% more. One can only marvel at the sheer genius required to convince the public that their lives are incomplete without a "Midnight Blue" version of the exact same object they already own. It takes a special kind of creativity to rebrand stagnation as progress, proving that if you add enough sleek adjectives to a mediocre concept, people will happily pay a premium for the privilege of being sold the same thing twice.
